title: China’s Top Spy Agency Recruited Woman Who Targeted Jensen Huang
summary: A memo that circulated among U.S. policymakers cited intelligence that Alice Huang, a Chinese executive who developed a relationship with Nvidia’s leader, was an asset of Beijing’s Ministry of State Security.
